visa-preparation.entry_summary: Moroccan-administered areas use Moroccan entry rules; Australians are visa-exempt for tourism up to three months. Access east or south of the Berm is a separate route.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Smartraveller covers Western Sahara under its Morocco advice: generally no visa for visits under 90 days.
steps: Entry is through Moroccan border control.

culture-cycles.public_holidays: Not in the machine holiday data. Calendars differ between the Moroccan-administered area and the Sahrawi-administered area and camps; ask locally.
moving_calendars: Ramadan 1448 expected to begin about 8 February 2027; Eid al-Fitr about 9 or 10 March 2027; Eid al-Adha about 16 or 17 May 2027; Islamic New Year 1449 about 5 to 7 June 2027. Expected dates from astronomical calculation; local moon sighting can move each by a day.
culture-cycles.note: Who sets dates depends on which administration you are under; ask your host.
